KARTIKEY TARARCOVERSHEET 01 / 07
Mechanism · side project · Oct 2026

Self-locking payload release for drones

A servo-driven release for a 0.8 kg payload that clamps onto two Ø10 mm carbon rods. Three limits set the brief: keep it light, keep it small, and put no load on the servo while it holds the payload.

LATCHA steel pin passes through the payload's eye bolt, driven by an MG996R servo through a scotch-yoke slider.
LOCKLatched, the yoke sits at dead centre, so the payload's weight cannot back-drive the servo.
RELEASEA 90° servo turn pulls the pin clear of the ring and the payload drops.
≈ 20Safety factor on the latch, FEA at 3 g vertical + 1 g forward
~72 gPrinted mass for a 0.8 kg payload
±2 mmCentre of mass from the rod centreline
KARTIKEY TARARPAYLOAD RELEASESHEET 02 / 07
Product concept · Oct 2026

Dewleaf: a leaf shower head for a baby bath

Concept for a baby-bath brand's design challenge: a soft sage leaf a parent holds to rinse water gently over a baby's head. It had to read clearly as a leaf, feel soft and safe, and be realistic to mould at scale.

  • Even flow. A Ø4.5 throat (≈16 mm²) is narrower than the 34 × Ø1.1 outlets combined (≈32 mm²), so the chamber fills at low, even pressure and every outlet gets the same push.
  • Construction. PP lid and base, ultrasonic-welded into a sealed chamber, then TPR overmoulded on top. The soft skin bonds permanently and can't trap water or come loose near a baby's face.
  • Mouldable. Outlets come from core pins; flush countersinks prevent flash; the TPR shuts off on the PP.
  • Dry tip. No outlets in the last 10 mm, so water runs away from the eyes.
MATERIALPP + TPR
HEAD100 × 72 mm
HOSEØ10 OD / Ø6 ID
OUTLETS34 × Ø1.1 mm
TOOLFusion 360
